svg.aria-label: Go on main: main holds the Go service: orgs, members, roles and the Zitadel user hook. Needs Postgres: SYNTHWERK_IDENTITY_DATABASE_URL is required. Migrations apply at startup. Epic E2 Identity: The rewrite is epic E2 Identity on the synthwerk map (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/synthwerk). It is in progress
